Each capability adds review cost, so the complete design is the hardest to merge and the incomplete one lands. Seven RFCs staged together are a program a maintainer must evaluate as a whole; one at a time, each looks like scope creep on the last. Neither shape is obviously right, and choosing the mergeable subset is choosing which obligations go undischarged.
